'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 SAN LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[SAN]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Communing (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-L-communing-pre.gif|label=Communing}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
